title: [E12-15] Wearable Network and API Non-Upload Verification
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E12-15 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/13

**User Story:**
As a privacy tester, I want to inspect wearable traffic and application contracts, so I can prove individual sensor and strain data never reaches commerce services.

**Epic:** E12 — Optional wearable safety, firmware & privacy  
**Domain:** IoT firmware / Local companion / Privacy  
**Type:** Test / Validation  
**Priority:** P1  
**Target Release:** B — Competition prototype — 10 December 2026  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Firmware/Privacy  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** US-036, US-039  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P1`, `release:B`, `epic:E12`, `iot-firmware`, `local-companion`, `privacy`

**Dependencies:** [E12-11](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/162), [E12-14](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/170), [E12-09](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/168)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: E12-11, E12-14; additional proposed blockers: E12-09.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Capture documented test network traffic; forbidden fields rejected; no sensor endpoint in commerce API; disconnection has no order/pay effects.
- [ ] Capture documented test traffic for enrollment, active sensing, reminders, summary, delete and disconnect.
- [ ] Inspect commerce payload/schema/logs for forbidden sensor, strain and reminder fields.
- [ ] Verify malformed monitoring payloads are rejected and no monitoring retrieval endpoint exists.
- [ ] Compare offers/pay/capacity before and after disabling the wearable.
- [ ] Report hardware and simulator evidence separately with actual pass/fail/blocker results.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Deliver redacted packet/API evidence, tested build identifiers and an explicit boundary-test report; missing hardware tests stay blocked.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Exercise real/local simulator paths under capture and attempt sensor injection plus admin access; verify zero monitoring upload and no commerce effects.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.

**Release Boundary:** Use isolated synthetic commercial records and distinguish simulation, observed evidence and physical hardware. This story does not authorize real contracts or live money movement.
